d:
Jan Suraaj Party chief Prashant Kishor often stays in the headlines due to his statements. Before the Bihar Assembly election results, the Khabargaon team had spoken to Prashant Kishor. Listen to what PK had said about Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar before the Bihar election results.
Jan suraj parti ke mukhiya prashant kishor apne bayanon ko lekar surkhiyon men rahte hain. bihar vidhanasbha chunav ki natijon se pahle khabarganv ki tim ne prashant kishor se bat ki thi. sunie bihar chunav rijalt se pahle pike ne bihar ke mukhyamantri nitish kumar ko lekar kya kaha tha?
